data.display_address: Elite Downtown Residence, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience modern urban living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Elite Downtown Residence, just moments away from the iconic Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai’s vibrant lifestyle attractions. Spanning 808.58 sqft, this beautifully designed residence offers a spacious layout with contemporary interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and abundant natural light throughout the apartment.


  The living and dining area is thoughtfully arranged to provide both comfort and functionality, while the modern open kitchen comes fitted with premium cabinetry and quality finishes. The generously sized bedroom includes built-in wardrobes and a relaxing ambiance ideal for comfortable city living. Residents can also enjoy stunning skyline and community views from the apartment.


  Property Features:
  • 1 Bedroom
  • 2 Bathrooms
  • Size: 808.58 Sqft
  • Bright Living & Dining Area
  • Modern Open Kitchen
  • Built-in Wardrobes
  • Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
  • Central Air Conditioning
  • Covered Parking


  Building Amenities:
  • Swimming Pool
  • Fully Equipped Gym
  • Sauna & Steam Room
  • Children’s Play Area
  • 24/7 Security & CCTV
  • High-Speed Elevators
  • Concierge Services


  Nearby Locations:
  • 5 mins to Dubai Mall
  • 5 mins to Dubai Fountain
  • Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
  • Close to restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets
